obs: "If the abrogation of that right had been in contemplation, it would naturally have been the subject of a provision suitably explicit. Rights of citizenship are not to be destroyed by an ambiguity."
Teague v. Regional Commissioner of Customs
"Ambiguities in statutory language should not be resolved so as to imperil a substantial right which has been granted."
